description.content:
Returns a list of deployments that match a given filter. Use query parameters to refine the search.

API Client needs the **Stage > View stage** permission for the operation.

query.description: Filter by environment key, if filled.
Filter by status of the deployment, if filled.
Filter deployments that contain given asset unique identifier, if filled.
Filter assets by revision number, if filled.
Filter assets by portfolio key, if filled.
Filter deployments that contain a given operation, if filled.
Filter deployments that contain a given operation, if filled.
Filter assets created from one point in time on, if filled.
Filter assets created up to one point in time, if filled.

Filter by permission type. Format: 'PermissionType' or 'PermissionType.EnvironmentKey' for environment-specific permissions. Available values: AppViewSourceCode | AppDebug | AppChange | AppDelete | AppDeploy | AppRelease | AppMonitor | AppMonitorUserInfo | AppSecurityView | CodeQualityManage | CodeQualityView | AppUserView | AppAccessManage | AppGroupManage | CfgView | ConnConfig | AppCfgChange. Example: 'AppDeploy' or 'AppDeploy.123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000'
Max number of elements that should be returned in a single page.
Offset of the last page, to get the following page with the same filters applied.

Sort order of the elements.
-element1 for descending, element2 for ascending.
Multiple orders joined by comma.
Example -element1,element2 to sort by element1 descending then by element2 ascending
Currently supported sort values: CreatedAt, UpdatedAt, ApplicationKey, AssetKey, ApplicationName, AssetName, FinishedAt
Default sort: -CreatedAt
